name.title: Dataset name
name.description: Stem of the Auspice JSON written to auspice/<name>.json. Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.

title.title: Title
title.description: Shown at the top of the tree in Auspice.

tree.title: Tree
tree.description: Newick tree. When blank, the one .nwk/.newick/.tree/.treefile in the input dataset is used.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: TSV or CSV with one row per tip. When blank, the one TSV/CSV in the input dataset is used.

alignment.title: Alignment
alignment.description: Optional FASTA alignment of the tips, for mutations on branches. When blank, the one FASTA in the input dataset is used if there is one.

metadata_id_columns.title: Strain column
metadata_id_columns.description: Metadata column holding the sequence names. Comma-separate several to try in order.

timetree.title: Time-resolved tree
timetree.description: Infer a timetree from the metadata's date column. Needs the alignment.

clock_rate.title: Clock rate
clock_rate.description: Fixed substitution rate in substitutions per site per year. Estimated from the data when blank.

clock_std_dev.title: Clock rate standard deviation
clock_std_dev.description: Uncertainty of a fixed clock rate.

root.title: Root
root.description: best, least-squares, min_dev or oldest, or one or two strain names (comma-separated) to root on. augur's default (best) when blank.

coalescent.title: Coalescent model
coalescent.description: Coalescent prior for the timetree: opt, const, skyline, or a number (Tc). None when blank.

clock_filter_iqd.title: Clock filter (IQD)
clock_filter_iqd.description: With a timetree, drop tips more than this many interquartile ranges off the clock. Off when blank.

traits.title: Traits to reconstruct
traits.description: Comma-separated metadata columns whose ancestral states are inferred, e.g. country,region.

color_by.title: Color by
color_by.description: Comma-separated metadata columns offered as colorings in Auspice.

geo_resolutions.title: Geographic resolutions
geo_resolutions.description: Comma-separated metadata columns to place on the map, e.g. region,country. Need coordinates from augur's defaults or a lat-longs file.

auspice_config.title: Auspice config
auspice_config.description: Optional auspice_config.json with colorings, filters and display defaults.

lat_longs.title: Lat-longs
lat_longs.description: Optional TSV of coordinates: resolution, name, latitude, longitude.
